name: Gossipcurrent Forks
introDiscord:
Three currents meet beneath the kelp and carry whispers from opposite
ends of the forest. Gossipcurrent Sprites dart between them, happily
collecting every rumor and improving none of them.
introTwitch:
Three currents meet beneath the kelp and carry whispers from opposite
ends of the forest. Gossipcurrent Sprites dart between them, happily
collecting every rumor and improving none of them.

gossipcurrent-forks-approach.prompt:
Three routes split with three murmuring currents. One insists treasure
lies left. Another insists danger lies left. The third says you already
went left.

left.message:
A Sprite zips from the current shouting a garbled imitation of your
arrival.

By the third repetition, you are apparently a terrifying royal invader.

The Sprite attacks accordingly.

right.message:
An offering basket hidden inside a root contains Star Candies.

A Sprite whispers:

'Ancient treasure.'

Another corrects:

'Found five minutes ago.'

Rumor lifespan: impressive.

forward.message:
Restorative sap rests under Shizuki's note:

'Current says I fought twelve sea dragons here.

Actual number: zero.

Please stop encouraging it.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the sap untouched. The current immediately whispers that you
drank seven bottles.

gossipcurrent-forks-depths.prompt: Living rootways divide into three forks crowded with chattering Sprites.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy bundle.

A Sprite announces:

'Secret treasure!'

Every Sprite within approximately half the forest immediately repeats
it.

right.message:
A Gossipcurrent Sprite tells another Sprite something while pointing at
you.

The second gasps.

The third gasps louder.

You have apparently become controversial.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's corrective notice:

'OFFICIAL STATEMENT:

I did NOT marry a crab.

I traded with ONE crab in Moonlit Reef.

Stop repeating this.'"

The current whispers:

'Shizuki married crab.'

Oh no.

gossipcurrent-forks-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds surround Whisperwell, where three currents circle a deep
root basin full of rapidly multiplying rumors.

left.message:
A tranquil grove pool rests beneath Shizuki's note:

'Drink here.

Ignore anything current says about ingredients.

It has no medical license.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched. Somewhere nearby, the current announces
you have achieved immortality.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer contains Star Candies and a tiny sign:

'NOT CURSED.'

A Sprite whispers:

'Extremely cursed.'

The sign seems more trustworthy.

forward.message:
A Sprite blocks your route and loudly announces:

'CHAMPION CHALLENGES TRAVELER!'

You look around for the champion.

The Sprite points at itself.

Confidence is admirable.

boss-antechamber.name: Whisperwell
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every rumor in the surrounding currents begins flowing toward
Whisperwell.

bossPromptDiscord:
The whispers circle faster.

Stories from every corner of the forest overlap until they become one
enormous voice.

Then something bright rises from the center of Whisperwell, surrounded
by dozens of excited Sprites.

Use /yes to enter Whisperwell or /no to leave before the rumor about
you gets any more impressive.
bossPromptTwitch:
The whispers circle faster.

Stories from every corner of the forest overlap until they become one
enormous voice.

Then something bright rises from the center of Whisperwell, surrounded
by dozens of excited Sprites.

Use !yes to enter Whisperwell or !no to leave before the rumor about
you gets any more impressive.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat. Behind you, several Sprites immediately begin telling the
story of your dramatic escape.

boss.revealText:
The currents burst into shimmering light as a powerful Sprite rises
from Whisperwell.

Rumor-Tide Sprite reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Rumor-Tide Sprite vanishes into the currents.

The forest immediately begins telling everyone you defeated something
at least three times larger.

Do not correct it."
